There is even a literal 'Sparse-Dense Mixture of Experts Adapter' (arxiv 2603.13719) and 'Sparse adapters... building blocks of modular architectures' that are merged into the base net. The candidate's dual-sided sparse-scaffold/dense-fill-fused-into-a-rigid-mass description is squarely covered.
